notes: No state-by-state or country-level headcount, investment or tax data is published. The FY2025 Sustainability Report gives employees by region only as percentages (Americas, APAC, EMEA, India), recorded as published; no headcount was derived. The 10-K says NVIDIA had approximately 36,000 employees in 38 countries and owns and leases facilities 'throughout the U.S. and in various international locations, primarily in China, India, Israel, and Taiwan' (no counts). The ~4,700 Israel figure is 'in the region' (in and around Israel) and sits inside EMEA, so it overlaps the EMEA percentage. Revenue by geography is in the records, not here.
